description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for verifying rebase behavior in Git when on-disk files are broken or conflicting. It sets up conflicts, manipulates author scripts, and checks for proper failure modes during rebases.

methods.name: create_conflict
methods.description: Creates a conflicting rebase scenario by checking out branches and initiating a rebase expected to fail.

methods.name: check_resolve_fails
methods.description: Checks that resolving conflict does not succeed during the rebase process, expecting failure.
